reason: As someone who already gave $200 elsewhere and remembers the refunds, B tells me what I need: my pledge comes back in full if it fails, $36,000 is already committed so only $49,000 remains, there's a reopening date, public spending reports, and candid caveats about the roof and film timing. A never says I'd get my money back this time and leaves the cinema unnamed with a bank placeholder, so it feels riskier and less credible.
